briefing: The quota stands, and it does not wait on courtesy. Pirates hold the lane the collective's shipment must cross, and {HERE} cannot meet its schedule while they do.
Clear the lane. Reach the surveyor's escape pod near the target, and land the passenger alive at a station. Then carry the manifest onward, on the collective's schedule.
{PATRON} speaks for the collective on this contract. Fulfil each term, and the collective confirms the contract fulfilled; nothing more is owed.
dossier.lead: {PATRON} at {WORLD} wants a word about a quota the collective must meet.

lane.arrive: Fly the lane to {TARGET} through whatever holds it, and dock, for {PAY}.
lane.success: The lane is clear, the ship docked at {TARGET}; the collective confirms {PAY} earned.
lane.fail: The lane beat the ship short of {TARGET}; the collective withholds {PAY}.

pod.arrive: Scoop the surveyor's pod near {TARGET}, and land the passenger alive, for {PAY}.
pod.success: The passenger is landed alive; the collective confirms {PAY} earned.
pod.fail: The pod is lost, sold, or the deadline passed; the collective withholds {PAY}.

route.arrive: Bring the surveyor's route back to {TARGET}, and dock, for {PAY}.
route.success: The route is delivered to {TARGET}; the collective confirms {PAY} earned.
route.fail: The route never reached {TARGET}; the collective withholds {PAY}.

manifest.arrive: Deliver the manifest to {TARGET}, and dock, for {PAY}.
manifest.success: The manifest is delivered to {TARGET}; the collective confirms {PAY} earned, contract fulfilled.
manifest.fail: The manifest never reached {TARGET}; the collective withholds {PAY}.

rumour.far: Traders report pirates holding the lane out of {WORLD}, and {PATRON} is looking for a pilot to clear it.
rumour.near: {PATRON} has docked one jump out, and sends word that the quota at {WORLD} still needs a pilot.

dossier.news: Work waits at {WORLD}, where {PATRON} still needs the lane cleared for the collective's shipment.

story.opening: On day {DAY}, the commander took on the collective's quota at {WORLD}.

closing.complete: By day {DAY}, the manifest had reached {WORLD}, and the collective's quota stood met.
closing.fail: By day {DAY}, the collective's quota at {WORLD} had gone unmet, and the contract lapsed.

lane.success: By day {DAY}, the lane to {WORLD} lay clear, and the ship docked through it.
lane.failed: By day {DAY}, the lane to {WORLD} had beaten the ship back.

pod.survivor:landed: By day {DAY}, the surveyor's passenger stepped alive onto {WORLD}.
pod.survivor:sold: By day {DAY}, the surveyor's passenger had been sold instead of saved, at {WORLD}.
pod.targetDestroyed: By day {DAY}, the surveyor's pod lay destroyed short of {WORLD}.
pod.failed: By day {DAY}, the pod run at {WORLD} missed its deadline.

route.success: By day {DAY}, the surveyor's route reached {WORLD} as ordered.
route.failed: By day {DAY}, the surveyor's route never reached {WORLD}.

manifest.success: By day {DAY}, the manifest reached {WORLD}, fulfilling the collective's contract.
manifest.failed: By day {DAY}, the manifest never reached {WORLD}.

dossier.title: The Vetitice Lane Quota
